units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 267:3">Yalk. Jer. 267</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 2:31">Jer. II, 31</cite>) <he>שמא … שהיא נאה והיא ארץ מ׳</he> did I tell them that it was a beautiful land, and it was a land of gloom?

senses.gloss: (homil.) lateness, procrastination. Ib. ד״א מאפילה שמא וכ׳ (corr. acc.) another interpretation; did I promise to bring you good things and procrastinate it? ואין מ׳ אלא לשון הלקשה, v. הַלְקָשָׁה; Tanḥ. B’midb. 2; Masé 9; Num. R. s. 1; s. 23; Yalk. Num. 683.
